notes.title: FISH³ is casting it's line for Steam Fishing Fest! + Demo 1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]Hey anglers and fishes, [/h3][p]I'm excited to announce that FISH³ is going to be part of Steam Fishing Fest starting Jun 16th until June 23rd!! Remember to wishlist the game and leave a review on the Demo! It helps with visibility, and directly supports development. [/p][h3]And with that, we have updated the demo to version 1.12 featuring many gameplay improvements, fixes, and most importantly - [b]stats and achievements![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588963/6701313254011bc32a8260e36e3ae33766fb43b8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Major Changes since 1.0:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stage Stats: Each stage will now store it's own stats - Best Time and Best Score. [/p][/*][*][p]Achievements: There's now 8 achievements in the Demo![/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial extended: you can freely practice after you finish the tutorial course.[/p][/*][*][p]Full controller support + Linux & SteamOS Build. [b]It's playable on Steam Deck![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Changed save file formatting to JSON. It will be rewritten from the old save file automatically.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some cases where fishing process can be interrupted (There still is an issue with Pausing during casting animation).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resolutions support.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing zone speed readjusted to match player speed more.[/p][/*][*][p]In-air behaviour improved. Ramps are more stable now.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Some more smaller fixes that I didn't write down.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]More updates coming this week, stay tuna'd![/b] The game is in active development so even if there's issues now, We will be doing our best for resolving them![/p][p]You can follow development on [url="https://twitter.com/LaZrick_" style="button"]Twitter[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/breadskate.how" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]. [/p][p]Happy fishing![/p]

tags.feature: Stage Stats: Each stage will now store it's own stats - Best Time and Best Score.
Achievements: There's now 8 achievements in the Demo!
Tutorial extended: you can freely practice after you finish the tutorial course.
Full controller support + Linux & SteamOS Build. It's playable on Steam Deck!
Changed save file formatting to JSON. It will be rewritten from the old save file automatically.

tags.bug: Fixed some cases where fishing process can be interrupted (There still is an issue with Pausing during casting animation).

tags.balance_change: Fishing zone speed readjusted to match player speed more.
In-air behaviour improved. Ramps are more stable now.
